game_name: Muscle Bomber Duo: Ultimate Team Battle (World 931206)
general_issues: Select mbombrd.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. TPO automatically assigns up to 4 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
